structure.early_stage: Sponsored validation ($20-50K wet lab) + option agreement (6-month exclusivity)
structure.medium_stage: Exclusive license with milestones ($50-200K upfront, $100-500K milestones, 3-7% royalty)
structure.mature_stage: Asset acquisition ($500K-$5M depending on evidence strength and market size)

buyer_gets: Exclusive rights to mechanism + evidence package + know-how + cemetery constraints + Discovery Evidence Fabric methodology for this domain
seller_retains: Discovery Evidence Fabric system itself (not domain-specific). Right to apply system to other domains.
